studies.title: Model scene: Talk in a diner turns into a standoff
studies.plain: Long, funny talk over coffee, a famous song on the jukebox, then the music is cut dead and guns come out. The crime-film pattern of a long hold followed by a sudden spike.

beats.note: the camera circles the table while they argue about nothing
a gun on the table; the jukebox stops
a shouted line into the silence
a deadpan line breaks the tension

studies.title: Model scene: Two strangers meet over the same book
studies.plain: Opposites reach for the same book, trade quick lines, and the light warms as they warm to each other.

beats.note: they start to like each other
a note left in the book

studies.title: Model scene: A dinner party goes wrong
studies.plain: A guest who can't read the room keeps talking; the camera refuses to cut away and the silences get longer.

studies.title: Model scene: Someone walks down a dark hallway
studies.plain: Silence instead of music, one sound pushed forward, empty frame, then a burst.

beats.note: a drip, louder than it should be

studies.title: Model scene: Practicing until they get good
studies.plain: One song carries many short shots of days passing, cuts on the beat, the light warming as the skill grows.

beats.note: the first success, in slow motion

studies.title: Model scene: A boring office meeting, filmed like a documentary
studies.plain: Handheld camera, people glancing at the lens, a manager who thinks they are funny.

studies.title: Model scene: A quiet goodbye at a doorway
studies.plain: No music at all, a held-back feeling, a long hold on a face, a hand that almost reaches.

studies.title: Model scene: One small mistake wrecks a kitchen
studies.plain: A dropped spoon starts a chain of bigger and bigger accidents, shown wide, with heightened sound and no real hurt.

beats.note: a calm line amid the wreck
